exposure: GCT 135 to 199 mg/dL with positive GTT
GDM diagnosis based on GCT 135 to 199 mg/dL with positive 3-hour glucose tolerance test (GTT)
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis based on 1-hour glucose challenge test (GCT) ≥ 200 mg/dL
Women diagnosed with GDM by 1-hour GCT ≥ 200 alone (≥ 200 group)
Women diagnosed with GDM by 1-hour GCT 135 to 199 mg/dL and confirmatory 3-hour GTT (< 200 group)
outcome: Maternal outcomes: A2DM, primary cesarean, failed trial of labor after cesarean
Perinatal outcomes: large/small for gestational age, birth injury
cohort: 827 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies complicated by GDM
finding: Women diagnosed with GDM solely on a 1-hour GCT ≥ 200 mg/dL had a significantly higher risk of developing preeclampsia and shoulder dystocia compared to women diagnosed with a positive 3-hour GTT following a GCT of 135 to 199 mg/dL.
